seo.title: Kids' Haircuts in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Kids' haircuts in Carlsbad, NM at Divinely Faded: fades, tapers and textured tops for young clients, by appointment on Booksy. Open Saturdays.

paragraphs: Kids are welcome in my chair.

The cuts on this page are the same fades and tapers I give adults, on smaller heads: a curly top over a skin fade, a low fade with a crisp line-up, a taper under a long textured top. Young clients get the same detail as everyone else.

alt.cut-kids-curly-top-skin-fade: Boy's curly top over a skin fade, side view
alt.cut-kids-low-fade: Boy's low fade with a short top and a squared line-up

blocks.heading: How parents book.
paragraphs: Booksy doesn't list a separate kids' service, so book the haircut that fits what your child wants [TIM?]. The Essential Haircut is {{price:essential-haircut}} and Booksy holds {{minutes:essential-haircut}} for it.
I work solo, so your kid sees the same barber every visit. That helps when they're still getting used to the clippers.
If your child has a picture of the cut they want, bring it. It saves guessing on both sides of the cape.

blocks.heading: What's in the photos.
paragraphs: A taper with a long, textured top keeps length up front and on the crown while the back and sides stay tight. A low fade with a line-up keeps everything short and squared off. A curly top over a skin fade lets natural curl sit on top of a clean side.
Kids who want lines cut in can add a hair design for {{addon:hair-design}}.

alt.cut-kids-taper-textured-top: Boy's taper fade with a long, textured top, rear three-quarter view

items.a: Booksy shows one price per service, with no separate rate for kids.

items.q: When can I bring my kid in?
items.a: Any open slot on Booksy. Saturdays run 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM, which helps around the school week. I'm closed Wednesday and Sunday.

alt.tim-outdoor-kids-cut: Tim cutting a young boy's hair in a barber chair under an outdoor canopy
